title: Min Stack
statement_md:
Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element in constant time $O(1)$.

Implement the `MinStack` class with methods `push(val)`, `pop()`, `top()`, and `getMin()`.

hints.text: Can you pair each value with the minimum value at the time it was pushed?
Use two stacks: a main data stack and an auxiliary min_stack.
On push(x), push min(x, min_stack[-1]) onto min_stack. On pop(), pop both stacks.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Two Stacks or Value-Min Tuples
Keeping an auxiliary stack that records minimums up to each stack height yields true $O(1)$ operations.
- **Time Complexity:** $O(1)$ for all operations
- **Space Complexity:** $O(n)$
